title: Per-input oracle enumerated on the admission split

quantities.median_oracle_depth: median over admission inputs of the depth of the per-input loss-minimizing sequence in the enumerated family
quantities.oracle_depth_q25: 25th percentile of the per-input oracle depth
quantities.oracle_depth_q75: 75th percentile of the per-input oracle depth
quantities.fraction_differs_from_qc: fraction of admission inputs whose oracle sequence differs from q_C

notes: Diagnostic enumerated on D_admit after every decision is fixed (convention C12). The lifecycle records only the D_explore global-candidate headroom (select/entry_complete.json), not a per-input oracle on the admission split.
